  chunk_output_type: console

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Environment and load packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(psych,
               ggplot2,
               tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               Hmisc,
               afex,
               lsmeans,
               rstatix,
               effectsize,
               cocor,
               sjPlot,
               sjmisc)

# Set your own wd here
setwd("")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
load("./Pilot to Study 4 cleaned and recoded (dis con).rda")

# Filter out partiicpants who met the exclusion criteria from the pre-registration. Note that we want to only filter out problem = 1 because problem = N/A for condition "not sick"
merged_df %<>% filter(problem == 0 | is.na(problem))

# center predictors
merged_df$severity_final_c = c(scale(merged_df$severity_final,
                                     center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$trans_risk_c = c(scale(merged_df$trans_risk, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$centrality_c = c(scale(merged_df$centrality, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$salience_c = c(scale(merged_df$salience, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$cur_stigma_c = c(scale(merged_df$cur_stigma, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$concern_co_c = c(scale(merged_df$concern_co, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))

# Sick df
sick_df <- filter(merged_df, condition == "sick")

# Not sick df
notsick_df <- filter(merged_df, condition == "notsick")
```

## Pre-registered primary analyses

```{r descriptives}
psych::describeBy(select(merged_df, trans_risk, severity_final, centrality, salience, cur_stigma, conceal_co, conceal_str, concern_co, concern_str), merged_df$condition)

# Number of people who reported never concealing
table(merged_df$conceal_co, merged_df$condition)
```

```{r correlations}
# severity X concealment, sick
cor.test(sick_df$severity_final, sick_df$conceal_co)

# severity X concealment, healthy
cor.test(notsick_df$severity_final, notsick_df$conceal_co)

# Compare correlations
cocor.indep.groups(cor(sick_df$severity_final, sick_df$conceal_co),
                   cor(notsick_df$severity_final, notsick_df$conceal_co),
                   nrow(sick_df),
                   nrow(notsick_df))
```

```{r multiple regression}
# Concealment
concealco_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ severity_final_c * condition, data = merged_df)
summary(concealco_lm)

ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = severity_final, y = conceal_co, fill = condition)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = condition), alpha = .25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(title = "Concealment likelihood by symptom severity")

simple_slopes(concealco_lm)

# Adding in covid concern as a covariate
concealCOVcon_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ concern_co_c + severity_final_c * condition,
                       data = merged_df)

summary(concealCOVcon_lm)
```
